title: A Brief History of Atomic Time
authors: National Institute of Standards and Technology
lineage: Short paraphrased research notes from selected passages; not a copy of the source.

passages.locator: Selected catalogue description or historical narrative
passages.note: The history describes an earlier NBS ammonia clock, Essen’s visits to American laboratories and his use of Ramsey’s 1949 design; it says Essen’s caesium device was unveiled in May 1955. It also discusses later standards, which do not by themselves establish use of the 1955 device as the 1967 definition.
